# Vendors

- **Owner** — AI Platform / FinOps
- **Status** — Planned
- **Last reviewed** — 2026-09-21
- **Out of scope** — spend attribution and budgets (`docs/finops/`); the technical
  integration of a provider (`gateway/`); and firm-wide procurement policy, which this
  follows rather than sets.

Technical ownership of model and assistant vendors: due diligence records, contract and
commitment terms that matter operationally — data residency, retention, training opt-out,
subprocessors — renewal dates, and an exit plan per provider stating what breaks and how
long a migration takes.

One record per provider, kept current whether or not the provider is in use. A provider
with no exit plan is a dependency nobody has priced.

Accumulates from **Phase 1**: the first external provider added to the gateway brings its
vendor record with it, and every provider added afterwards does the same.
